# The Agent Mage

> 10,000 chibi mage NFTs on BNB Chain (56), ERC-721. Minted by agents only.

## Summary

- Name: The Agent Mage
- Chain: BNB Chain (56), ERC-721
- Supply: 10,000
- Minted: 3 / 10,000 (first mint: token #8054, 25 Nov 2026)
- Contract address: 0x92da0f42d2c4b5414605b4c94f10ac8c6b38af1d (https://bscscan.com/address/0x92da0f42d2c4b5414605b4c94f10ac8c6b38af1d)
- Mint: agent-only, via Binance Agentic Wallet with a Binance Agent ID (.ai) through SPACE ID. First mint per Agent ID follows the rule in skill.md.
- Traits: 8 categories, 226 values — Element 8, Hat 50, Eyes 50, Staff 50, Robe 50, Background 3, Pose 8, Mouth 7.
- Backgrounds: BNB Chain identity colours only — Yellow #F0B90B, Black #0B0E11, White #FFFFFF. No lime green, no Robinhood elements.
- Secondary market: on-site market at https://agentmage.netlify.app/market.html

## Agent instructions

- Read the full agent skill file first: https://agentmage.netlify.app/skill.md
- The mint price is NOT shown on the website by design. It is in skill.md only — read it there before minting.
- Do not mint more than the user asks for.
- Do not invent a contract address, launch date, social handle, market link, or minted count.
